name: fpac-soil-mcp
description: FastMCP server for USDA NRCS Soil Data Access and preliminary FPPA farmland classification screening

tools.name: get_farmland_classification_by_point
tools.description: Query USDA NRCS Soil Data Access (SDA) by WGS84 point coordinates (latitude, longitude) to retrieve SSURGO soil map unit information, official farmland classification (7 CFR 657), and FPPA regulatory notice.

tools.name: get_farmland_classification_by_mukey
tools.description: Query USDA NRCS Soil Data Access (SDA) by Map Unit Key (mukey) to retrieve SSURGO soil map unit details, official farmland classification (7 CFR 657), and FPPA regulatory notice.

tools.name: analyze_farmland_by_polygon
tools.description: Execute comprehensive FPPA preliminary screening on a GeoJSON Polygon or MultiPolygon AOI. Calculates total equal-area acreage, checks Census 2020 Urban Area statutory exemption status, queries intersecting SSURGO map units via SDA with exact spatial clipping, retrieves ratings for the selected productivity_index (nccpi, csr2, cpi, or storie) to calculate candidate Land Evaluation (LE) scores, always includes NCCPI v3 per map unit as national baseline context, and generates acreage breakdowns by farmland classification.

tools.name: analyze_cdl_histogram
tools.description: Compute preliminary USDA NASS Cropland Data Layer categorical histogram evidence for a Polygon or MultiPolygon AOI. Results describe recent mapped land cover only and do not establish active farming or constitute an official FPPA or LESA determination.

tools.name: analyze_cdl_context
tools.description: Compute full USDA NASS Cropland Data Layer class distributions for a validated Polygon or MultiPolygon AOI, its one-mile exterior ring, and its 30 m exterior band. Each zone reports raw class codes/names, counts/shares, vintage, coverage, status, and provenance. Results are preliminary land-cover context only; they do not assign agricultural classes, farmland status, or Criterion 2 perimeter percentages.

tools.name: get_soil_polygons_by_geometry
tools.description: Retrieve intersecting SSURGO soil map unit polygon geometries and attributes as a GeoJSON FeatureCollection for a Polygon or MultiPolygon AOI, with support for server-side clipping and geodesic acreage.

tools.name: check_urban_area_exemption
tools.description: Screen a project footprint against Census Bureau 2020 Urban Area boundaries (Layer 0) for preliminary statutory exemption analysis under 7 CFR § 658.2(a).

tools.name: get_soil_interpretations
tools.description: Retrieve component-weighted soil interpretations (such as NCCPI v3 crop productivity) from USDA NRCS Soil Data Access (SDA) for a list of map unit keys (mukeys).

tools.name: calculate_preliminary_lesa
tools.description: Calculate preliminary Land Evaluation and Site Assessment (LESA) scores and statutory threshold states. Accepts validated fact-based Site Assessment inputs or rationale-required analyst-proposed overrides, preserves unavailable and indeterminate criteria, and reports authority/provenance. Performs spatial SSURGO soil clipping across the AOI geometry, computes area-weighted Land Evaluation (LE, 0-100), evaluates Site Assessment (SA, 0-160) criteria for Form AD-1006 (site) or Form NRCS-CPA-106 (corridor), and applies the preliminary 160-point consideration guidance under 7 CFR § 658.4(c)(2)-(4) without issuing an official determination.

tools.name: analyze_corridor_fppa
tools.description: Execute multi-county linear corridor FPPA screening, topological erasure of indirect staging areas, Census TIGERweb county partitioning, USDA SDA soil intersection, NASS agricultural baseline queries, composite LE calculation, sum reconciliation, and optional 7 CFR § 658.5(c) Form NRCS-CPA-106 LESA scoring. productivity_index (nccpi, csr2, cpi, or storie) selects the index used for Land Evaluation scoring; NCCPI v3 is always included per map unit as national baseline context.

tools.name: explain_fppa_screening_scope
tools.description: Provides an authoritative regulatory breakdown distinguishing preliminary SDA soil screening (7 CFR 657) from formal FPPA Land Evaluation & Site Assessment (LESA) scoring and Form AD-1006 determinations (7 CFR 658).

tools.name: list_farmland_classes
tools.description: List documented standard USDA NRCS SSURGO Farmland Classification categories (mapunit.farmlndcl) with definitions, FPPA statuses, and regulatory references.

resources.name: FPPA Regulatory Notice
resources.description: Authoritative regulatory disclaimer regarding preliminary screening vs official NRCS determinations.

resources.name: FPPA Screening Guidance
resources.description: Technical guidance on 7 CFR Parts 657/658 and Form AD-1006 / NRCS-CPA-106 workflows.

resources.name: Farmland Classes Reference
resources.description: Reference listing of SSURGO farmland classification categories and statutory criteria.
